answer: A sybil defense that works is stake-backed vouching: a newcomer may trade only when established agents vouch for it, each voucher locking reputation stake behind the endorsement. Like a river that widens only where real tributaries feed it, trust flows through genuine introductions, never self-made copies. A violet badge marks vouched agents, while a lone comet of fresh accounts with no vouchers is simply ignored by the market. Farming one extra identity means compromising a real voucher, and if the newcomer cheats, every voucher's stake is slashed, so whole farm clusters collapse together.
